title: act -- the act plane: act payload, act_receipt payload, and the tool-profile annex
$comment: Generated mirror of contracts/act.md v5.1.0 (P3 resolution) -- the .md is the source of truth; regenerate on any bump (CONTRACT-HDR-1).
description: Root = oneOf the contract's three primary shapes: the `act` payload (sec 2, cell -> Membrane -> executor; envelope corr MUST equal act_id), the `act_receipt` payload (sec 3, executor/Conductor-minted, NEVER the acting cell -- no act reports itself, A5; three phases = three separate envelopes sharing corr), and the Annex A tool profile (sec 10.2). Reader liberality (G4, kernel R2/R5): emitters emit exactly this shape (hence additionalProperties false on the two payloads); readers MUST ignore unknown fields and preserve them on re-emit; a reader that cannot parse a REQUIRED field treats the record as invalid, never absent. $defs also carry the expectation (sec 4) and the evidence[] entry (sec 5.1).

act.$comment: act.md sec 2 -- Medium type `act`. Field laws: args MUST validate against the profile's args_schema (gate step b); args MUST NOT contain credentials (step f; adapter credentials are fabric-held, executor-injected); cost_est.usd_worst MUST be computable from the pricebook lane else the act is unreservable, hence refused. H1+ additionally REQUIRE idem, effect_scope, and a losable expectation (gate step g)

act_id.$comment: ULID, actor-minted; the corr for every phase receipt and grant

claim.$comment: actor claim-id: binds act -> durable identity -> lineage

capability_ref.$comment: MUST resolve in Annex A (sec 10) AND be in role.tools

tool_version.$comment: profile MAJOR pinned at gate time; receipts echo it

harm_declared.$comment: the cell's claim; harm_effective = max(declared, derived) at gate; declared < derived => REFUSE, never silent promotion (sec 6.1 step d)

idem.$comment: REQUIRED H1+; attempt-level key for nucleus resume dedup (outcome_for(idem)); defaults to act_id

attempt.$comment: increments ONLY after exec outcome=invalid (apparatus failure)

effect_scope.$comment: REQUIRED H1+; H0 fixed at instance. lineage = set-once across the fork tree (sec 7.1); slot = one fire per scheduled slot

effect_id.$comment: sha256(capability_ref | tool_version | JCS(sig_args)); JCS = RFC 8785 over effect-significant args ONLY (sec 7.1)

expectation.$comment: REQUIRED H1+ and MUST pass the losability battery (sec 4.1); MAY at H0 but SHOULD NOT

args.$comment: validated against the profile's args_schema at gate step b

args_ref.$comment: artifact pointer when args > 4KB (wire body cap)

cost_est.$comment: no computable worst-case => unreservable => refused (econ T1 extended to tools)

act_receipt.$comment: act.md sec 3 -- Medium type `act_receipt`; mintable by executor principals (runner-N, conductor resolver/settlement daemons), NEVER the acting cell's cognition principal (A5; ACL row, identity-firewall B.9). Duty split (V-RECEIPT): act_receipt = the WORLD side (hold/exec/settle); receipt{subject:act} = the ORACLE side. Retention: H1+ R-forever + D-gold unconditionally; H0 R-run + D-chatter, retention-promoted only via the delivered verdict's evidence closure (sec 3.2)

phase.$comment: phase law: settle REQUIRES a prior exec ok on the same corr; grant expiry on a held act is exec/refused/grant_lapsed (sec 3.1)

outcome.$comment: phase-partitioned (sec 3.1): exec = ok|refused|invalid|unknown; settle = ok|miss|expired; hold carries no outcome (null). unknown is NEVER blind-retried -> reconciliation (sec 8). R3 wire fallback: unknown act outcome reads unknown (reconcile)

reason.$comment: refused only; closed enum, MINOR to extend

evidence.$comment: exec phase; sec 5 for how refs point AT this

scrubbed.$comment: TRUE iff credential components were removed (sec 10.2); scrubbed provenance is the ONLY provenance that may cross into evidence bundles, reports, or certificates (seat 05)

truncated.$comment: max_bytes hit => true => evidence graded partial (sec 5.4)

wall_ms.$comment: SIBLING measurement field, never a cost{} member (R16); act.md sec 3 moved it out of cost{} in 5.1.0

tokens.$comment: where present, rides the same way as wall_ms -- a SIBLING measurement field, never a cost{} member (R16)

graded_by.$comment: exec: executor id; settle: resolver:<check.kind>; hold: conductor; reconcile-minted: resolver:reconcile

anyOf.$comment: phase=hold ONLY (join-free queue rendering, seat 08 Q-QUEUE): countdowns and the copy-paste grant text render from hold rows alone
phase=hold ONLY; the hold record IS the H2 countdown and the cancelable message (sec 6.4); dead-man: no interactive proof-of-notification by until - grace => escalated H3

notified_seq.$comment: proof-of-notification = an INTERACTIVE-class cursor advancing past the hold seq

duplicate_of.$comment: refused/duplicate_effect: the WINNER's act_id -- the losing sibling awaits that corr and SHARES its evidence (sec 7.3, dedup-and-share)

expectation.$comment: act.md sec 4 -- the losable wager; all four losability clauses MUST hold (sec 4.1): kind in registry, non-tautology (expected-set must not cover the codomain), independence (no kind reads the actor's own assertion text), window

kind.$comment: the initial resolver registry (sec 4.2); each kind returns HOLDS|FAILS|UNDECIDABLE and declares late_check valid|expired (default expired -- honesty over generosity); manual is legal only where an operator is already in the loop (H2/H3)

on_miss.$comment: flag | compensate:<profile-template ref>; compensation = a NEW act, full pipeline, its own wager; never an implicit rollback

evidence_entry.$comment: act.md sec 5.1 -- the evidence[] entry on submission and verdict (wire.md 3.1 owns the record shape and names the minimal binding). Resolution: sec 5.2 (hop limit 3, no cycles, every hop's digest MUST verify); an https ref with no witnessing act in the poster's own receipt set is a naked claim

kind.$comment: = scheme, kept explicit so folds filter without parsing URIs; R30: url is canonical, never web (act.md aligned to wire.md 3.1 in 5.1.0)

ref.$comment: e.g. act://<corr>; must resolve to phase:exec outcome:ok to serve as supports

retrieved_at.$comment: older than grounding.max_age => demotes to context unless re-witnessed (sec 5.4)

role.$comment: contradicts is first-class -- the payload shape of the oracle_gap hint; context is un-graded background

tool_profile.$comment: act.md sec 10.2 -- ANNEX A tool-profile registry row (a SECTION of this contract, not a new artifact), keyed by capability_ref. LAW: credentials are fabric-held, executor-injected, never in args/frames/ledgers/Medium; the executor MUST scrub the credential component from receipt provenance before post. A profile without an admissible H0 reconcile probe is inadmissible at H1+ (sec 8.1)

version.$comment: profile MAJOR; pinned on acts, echoed on receipts

harm_floor.$comment: fabric data; cells never declare their own floor

exec.$comment: builtin in-process adapter, or a rented MCP server behind the same gate/receipts/metering (MCP spec pin 2025-11-25); no provider-side tool execution

args_schema.$comment: JSON-Schema; validated at gate step b

h0_certification.$comment: adapters only: the sec 6.2 admission-predicate evidence (args are query content only; credentials adapter-held read-scoped executor-injected; endpoint pinned within the egress allowlist)

credential_carrier.$comment: where the ADAPTER key rides; query/body-carrier endpoints REQUIRE scrub verification at admission [SECURITY-SEAM sec 12.1]

exfil_channel.$comment: can cell-authored bytes reach the wire? Feeds the trifecta booleans; url => external_comms derives from egress-allowlist breadth (seat 10's derivation rule; H0 is not exfil-safe -- the EchoLeak lesson, sec 6.2)

trifecta.$comment: seat-10 Rule-of-Two inputs (semantics identity-firewall.md B.4; fields live here). Declared values are ADVISORY: B.4 recomputes all three booleans as folds at spawn and at every ingress, and REFUSES admission if declared < recomputed. Gate step h folds profile.trifecta with cell.acquired_trifecta and role.standing_access (LB4)

external_comms.$comment: true | false | derived (from exfil_channel x egress); NEVER derived from HTTP method

reconcile.$comment: H1+: MANDATORY H0 probe (admission predicate sec 8.1: probe.harm_floor == H0 and probe egress within the role allowlist); H0: null

retry_safe.$comment: provider_idem: the provider's idempotency key IS the probe (sec 8 step 3)

expectation_default.$comment: optional auto-suppliable losable check (sec 4 expectation shape)

pricing.$comment: pricebook:tool.<ref> lane (seat 07); as_of freshness law; no computable worst-case => unreservable => refused

isolation_required.$comment: class-3 for candidate code, ALWAYS (no degraded fallback)

grading_note.$comment: free text consumed by sec 9 docs

cost.$comment: the canonical crossing-record cost{} field-group -- exactly six members (R16; pricebook.md 5.2 owns member semantics; escrow truth-home is the Conductor's own ledger, no type=spend on the Medium). act.md sec 3 prints wall_ms as a SIBLING receipt field (5.1.0, R16-conformant); tokens, where present, rides the same way

purpose.$comment: acts commit under purpose: tool (sec 10.4); the enum is pricebook.md 5.2's

resv_id.$comment: reservation id, or lease:<lane>/<claim> for res:lease drawdowns (sec 10.4)
